newsitem.title: UK: Gulf Canada says has $1 bln loan for Clyde buy.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Canada says has $1 bln loan for Clyde buy.

text.p: LONDON, Dec 18 (LPC) - Gulf Canada Resources Ltd has a $1 billion bank loan to back its hostile 432 million stg cash offer for Britain's Clyde Petroleum, Gulf's president and chief executive, J.P. Bryan, said.
Gulf Canada said Wednesday it was making a cash offer of 105 pence per share for Clyde. Clyde has rejected the offer.
The one year credit is provided by Bank of Montreal and will by syndicated at a later date.
Earlier today Bryan told reporters in a conference call that Gulf plans an offering of its stock and a flotation of its Indonesian unit next year to help fund the proposed acquisition of Clyde.

He said the stock offering would raise about $100 million. Planned assets sales of some $300 million in 1997 would be supplemented by a 20 percent float of the Indonesian unit which could raise $300 million to $400 million, Bryan said.
